name: Kabutoyama Mitori
source:
Hobbies: Origami
Skills: Traditional Japanese dancing
Likes: Green tea, colorful folding paper
Dislikes: Crooks and villains

A 7th-year student and the vice president of the Crowns. She is the heiress and next in line to be the head of the prestigious Kabutoyama family. She carries her paper fan with her wherever she goes, and her graceful smile rarely ever leaves. Between her elegant demeanor, boundless good manners, and generous disposition, she's very clearly the daughter of a well-to-do household.

She's always looking out for her allies, be they friend or business partner, and she often has [url=/c17298]Saku's[/url] back after she delivers particularly harsher scoldings. Despite her position as a Crown, she actually values [url=/c17297]Shinri's[/url] abilities and strong willpower quite highly.

"He certainly is the type of man the Academy... Nay, this world has never seen."

[Edited from [url=https://hello.nekonyansoft.com/chara.html]official English page[/url]]
